title: Stalk image inclusion range
statement: For a morphism of O_X-modules f : M ⟶ N, the range of the stalk of the canonical image inclusion equals the range of the stalk of f.

proof.text: Apply the image clause of module_stalk_exact to f at x. It gives equality of the linear range of the stalk of Abelian.image.ι f and the range of the stalk of f.

Mathlib Abelian.imageIsoImage identifies the abelian image with the categorical image. Map its hom through the stalk functor. Functoriality and imageIsoImage_hom_comp_image_ι identify its composite with the mapped categorical image inclusion as the mapped abelian image inclusion.

The mapped isomorphism hom is an epimorphism in ModuleCat, hence its linear map is surjective. LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top shows that precomposition with this map leaves the range unchanged. Substitute this into the equality from step 1.

lean.statement: theorem stalk_image_inclusion_range {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) (x : X) : let S := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x LinearMap.range (S.map (image.ι f)).hom = LinearMap.range (S.map f).hom
